sections: The Translational Potential of this Article

encoding_notes: Encoded from Wayback snapshot 2024-03-04 of the ScienceDirect guide; live page is bot-blocked (HTTP 403) and no snapshot <12mo exists. Journal still on Elsevier/ScienceDirect (no publisher migration found).

Publisher: 'published quarterly by Elsevier'; official journal of the Chinese Speaking Orthopaedic Society (CSOS) and International Chinese Musculoskeletal Research Society (ICMRS). Some JOT surfaces show KeAi co-publishing/production, but the guide names Elsevier.

Article-type mapping: Original article->original_research; Review article->review; Case reports (covers 'a case or case series')->case_report + case_series; Letter to the Editor->letter; Editorial->editorial.
Perspectives OMITTED — no clean schema slot (4000-word limit, abstract <=50 words, <=35 refs, 1-2 figs). Guide also lists a Graphical abstract (optional, min 531x1328 px @96dpi).

COMBINED figure+table caps that the schema (separate figures_max/tables_max) can't hold, so left null: original_research <=8 figures/tables total; review <=4; letter <=2; perspectives 1-2. Guide: 'not more than 8 figures/tables' etc. Also 'no limit on the number of pages, figures, or colour figures' stated for print, but per-type caps above govern manuscript body.
Figure DPI is TIERED (schema holds one int; set to the 300 floor): halftones/photographs >=300 dpi; bitmapped line drawings >=1000 dpi; combination line/halftone >=500 dpi.

Abstract: general cap is 500 words (original, review, perspectives, case reports) but the Types-of-article section gives tighter per-type caps used in word_limits: review 100, editorial has no abstract, letter has no abstract. Original-article abstract is structured (Background/Objective, Methods, Results, Conclusion); review abstract structured only for systematic reviews/meta-analyses, unstructured otherwise; case reports/perspectives = single paragraph, no subheadings.
'The Translational Potential of this Article' is a required heading immediately after the abstract, counted within the abstract word count — included as final abstract section.

Two title pages required by double-anonymized review: first title page carries author details + running title + acknowledgements + Declaration of Interest; second title page carries ONLY article type + article title (heads the anonymized manuscript).

Tables placement is author-choice per guide ('either next to the relevant text ... or on separate page(s) at the end'); set grouped_end to match the prescribed article structure (Figures and Tables listed at end). Avoid vertical rules.
Figure callout_style left null: guide never shows a main-text callout; appendix example uses 'Fig. A.1' but that is appendix-specific, not inferred to body callouts.
include_doi=true reflects guide's 'Use of the DOI is highly encouraged' (encouraged, not strictly mandatory).

Body text: single-column, British English spelling, do NOT justify or hyphenate (=> alignment left). Manuscript body font family/size NOT specified (illustration fonts Arial/Courier/Times New Roman are for artwork only).
scrub_metadata=false: guide requires scrubbing author identifiers from body/refs/figures/tables/acknowledgements but does not explicitly mention stripping file/document-property metadata.
